scope: All 15 existing Go corpus cases rerun through controlled-go-regression.yml on test/try-public-pr-workflow. Original corpus logs and expected answers were not modified.
limitations: SSA dependency paths are not proof of branch feasibility, complete aliases, concurrency ordering, or a violated invariant.
Five traces reached the explicit traversal limit; six completed within it. Coverage is reported separately from mechanism correctness.
One nested-module fixture lacked a loaded SSA test body; two non-race fixtures lacked an assertion anchor and used fallback source inspection. The race case remains on the concurrency path.
The pgx fixture remains a localization miss: the dispatch file is retrieved, but the upstream uint64 codec fix file is absent from likely_files.
Mechanism verification requires upstream function annotations and dedicated verified mechanism evidence; no mechanism success is claimed here.
